zoneName: Deep Black Cotton Soils (Deccan Basalt Plains)
drainageCharacteristics: Imperfectly drained; prone to waterlogging in heavy rains and deep cracking when dry
managementNotes: Ideal for Rabi moisture-retentive crops such as Chickpea and Rabi Sorghum; avoid surface ponding during Kharif Soybean.

typicalTexture: Clay Loam to Silty Clay Loam
managementNotes: Supports Soybean-Chickpea or Cotton-Pigeon Pea systems when supplemented with organic matter.

drainageCharacteristics: Excessively drained with rapid moisture loss
managementNotes: Best matched to short-duration drought-hardy crops like Pearl Millet and Pigeon Pea with soil moisture conservation.
